finding: NO DEDICATED-ANALYSIS PAPER EXISTS for GRB 100614B / bn100614498. The refereed footprint is 2 catalog memberships with printed rows (Paciesas+2012, Hurley+2013), 1 machine-readable-only catalog membership (Goldstein+2012), and 1 sample-row reuse (Heussaff+2013, chained from Goldstein). Zero circulars (tcat GCN_FLAG=No), zero afterglow record, no redshift. The external comparison frame for the P3 diff is the GBM catalog machinery itself: HEASARC scat v03 (dets b1,n6,n9; flnc interval [-90.114,+17.408] s; Band Ep=41.39+5.07/-5.60 keV, alpha=-0.800, beta=-2.185; SBPL Ebreak=20.88 keV tied with Band; pflx interval [-4.096,0] s PRE-trigger, Comp Ep=78.2+12.6/-21.6) + bcat v02 (T90=172.291+/-12.447 s from T90START=-149.763 s - the D4 flag: our stamped window -13..+16 s covers only the trigger pulse and our pre-burst bkg sits inside the catalog T90 span; human-accepted flag results/human_review_qc_flags.txt line 2). All filed with component-coverage labels in results/gcn/bn100614498/bn100614498_dossier.md.
